title: Build Project Specification & RFQ / RFP Portal Across 6 Service Verticals
description: Per user request to build the next most important page ('make the next most important page you decide'), engineered the enterprise-grade Project Specification & RFQ / RFP Portal at `app/rfq/page.tsx` ('use client'). As the primary commercial conversion gateway linked across the announcement bar, mega-menu, mobile navigation drawer, framing journey, FAQ, and footer, this portal connects residential art collectors (B2C), commercial architects & enterprises (B2B), and public sector institutions (GeM compliant tenders) directly with Frame Cottage's engineering, fabrication, and archival framing capabilities. Features an interactive 5-step specification builder powered by Framer Motion: 1. Client Tier Selection (B2C, B2B, Public Sector); 2. Core Service Verticals Multi-Select across the 6 exact studio verticals; 3. Materials (Solid Appalachian Hardwoods, Architectural Metals, TruVue® UV99 Acrylic, K9 Optical Crystal, Engineered Acrylics) and Technical Capabilities (3D Spatial Modeling, CNC ±0.1mm, Fine Art Printing, On-Site Rigging, Institutional Crating); 4. Project Scope (Volume 1-10, 10-100, 100-1,000, 1,000-10,000+), Timeline (<2w, 3-4w, Phased), GeM Tender ID input, and Blueprint/Artwork CAD/DWG drop zone; 5. Client Details Form with a Live Project Scope Summary sidebar that updates dynamically. Upon submission, generates an official Project RFQ Reference ID, assigns Senior Studio Lead Vikram Singhania, provides client-side downloadable PDF/JSON summary, direct consultation booking, and complete reset capabilities. Full test suite passes 100% (52/52 tests) and Next.js Turbopack build succeeds with 0 errors.
